description: Load concise MR Studio context at session start, reset, or compaction

hooks.commandWindows: python -c "from pathlib import Path; import runpy; p=next((d / '.codex/hooks/session_start.py' for d in (Path.cwd(), *Path.cwd().parents) if (d / '.codex/hooks/session_start.py').is_file()), None); p and runpy.run_path(str(p), run_name='__main__')"
